title: Understanding Gender-Based Violence
summary: Build a foundation in consent, coercive control, survivor-centred support and safer referral.

title: Types and Forms of Gender-Based Violence
summary: Understand different forms, how they overlap, and respectful ways to offer support.

title: Root Causes, Risk Factors, and Gender Inequality
summary: Explore unequal power, connected influences and prevention without blame or stereotypes.

title: Understanding Consent, Boundaries, and Bodily Autonomy
summary: Explore freely given consent, personal boundaries, bodily autonomy and safety when choice is constrained.

title: Domestic Violence and Intimate Partner Violence
summary: Recognize coercive control, understand barriers to help, and learn about respectful support and Rwanda referral pathways.

title: Sexual Violence, Harassment, and Exploitation
summary: Understand consent, abuse of authority, safer first responses, time-sensitive care and safeguarding.

title: Emotional, Psychological and Verbal Abuse
summary: Understand harmful patterns, distinguish abuse from disagreement, and explore safety-aware support.

title: Economic Violence and Financial Control
summary: Learn how money, work, property and digital access can be used to control, and how support can preserve choice.

title: Technology-Facilitated and Online Gender-Based Violence
summary: Explore digital abuse, consent, privacy, institutional responsibilities and responses that put safety first.

title: Gender-Based Violence Against Children and Adolescents
summary: Learn about child protection, safe disclosure, age-appropriate support and pathways to help in Rwanda.
